skill.name: docs-write
skill.description: Helps create and edit Metabase documentation in a conversational, clear, and user-focused style for Markdown and MDX files.
skill.summary: Create Metabase-style documentation that is clear, conversational, and useful for readers.
skill.author: metabase

content.value_statement: Product documentation often becomes too formal, vague, or hard to scan. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code write Metabase-style docs that are clear, direct, and reader focused.
actual_capabilities: Drafts documentation in Metabase style for Markdown and MDX files.
Rewrites formal or vague text into clear, conversational language.
Applies guidance for headings, links, UI labels, code formatting, and terminology.
Organizes instructions so actions appear before supporting context.
Checks documentation for stale numbers, weak examples, and unclear reader guidance.
limitations: It does not verify product behavior unless the needed source or docs are available.
It cannot guarantee examples work without running or reviewing them in the project.
It is tuned for Metabase documentation and may not match other brand voices.
It may need human review for legal, support, or release-sensitive wording.

use_cases.title: Create a new docs page
use_cases.description: Turn a feature brief or rough outline into a clear documentation page with reader-focused structure.

use_cases.title: Edit product copy in docs
use_cases.description: Revise draft documentation so headings, steps, links, and examples follow Metabase writing conventions.

use_cases.title: Prepare developer documentation
use_cases.description: Improve setup, configuration, and troubleshooting instructions before publishing or review.

prompt_templates.title: Rewrite a short section
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner edit for a small documentation passage.
prompt_templates.prompt: Rewrite this documentation section in Metabase style. Keep the meaning, make the language clearer, and preserve any technical terms I provide.

prompt_templates.title: Draft from an outline
prompt_templates.scenario: Create a first draft from notes or a product brief.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this outline to draft a Metabase-style documentation page. Lead with the reader action, use sentence-case headings, and include only useful context.

prompt_templates.title: Review before publishing
prompt_templates.scenario: Check a nearly finished Markdown or MDX file.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this documentation for Metabase style. Flag unclear headings, weak links, formal language, fragile examples, and wording that may become outdated.

prompt_templates.title: Refactor a complex guide
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced cleanup for a long or technical guide.
prompt_templates.prompt: Restructure this guide for a mixed technical audience. Keep required details, move actions before explanations, and explain every major edit you make.

output_examples.input: A rough paragraph explains a setup task with formal language and a vague heading.
output_examples.output: A clearer section with a specific heading, a direct first step, and plain language that explains why the step matters.

output_examples.input: A documentation page uses "click here" links, vague headings, and UI labels formatted as code.
output_examples.output: A revised page with descriptive links, sentence-case headings, and bold UI labels where the reader sees interface text.

output_examples.input: A long troubleshooting guide mixes background details with required actions.
output_examples.output: A reorganized guide that puts the required actions first, keeps context close to each step, and removes low-value text.

best_practices: Provide the audience, product context, and target file format before asking for a draft.
Include source material or product behavior notes so the skill can avoid guessing.
Ask for a final style pass after technical accuracy has been checked.
anti_patterns: Do not ask it to invent product behavior, limits, or release details without evidence.
Do not use it as the only review for sensitive support, pricing, or legal content.
Do not apply the Metabase voice guide to unrelated brands without adapting the style requirements.

faq.question: What type of writing does this skill improve?
faq.answer: It improves technical documentation, product guides, setup instructions, and Markdown or MDX content for Metabase-style docs.

faq.question: Can it create a full documentation page?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide an outline, source notes, or feature details so it can draft a structured page.

faq.question: Does it verify technical accuracy?
faq.answer: It can review provided examples for clarity, but it needs project context or test results to confirm behavior.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude Code or Codex?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill declares support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows.

faq.question: Does it run formatting commands?
faq.answer: The skill recommends using the project Prettier command after edits. Review command output before committing changes.

faq.question: Is it only for Metabase documentation?
faq.answer: It is optimized for Metabase style. Other teams can still use it as a focused documentation style guide.
